# Psalm 77 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** To-the-choirmaster. Over Jeduthun. Of-Asaph. A-psalm. My-voice to-God and-I-will-cry-out; my-voice to-God and-give-ear to-me.

**2** In-day-of my-distress the-Lord I-sought; my-hand at-night was-stretched-out and-not grew-numb; refused to-be-comforted my-soul.

**3** I-remember God and-I-moan; I-meditate and-faints my-spirit. Selah.

**4** You-held-open the-watches-of my-eyes; I-was-troubled and-not I-could-speak.

**5** I-considered the-days of-old, the-years of-ages-past.

**6** I-remember my-song in-the-night; with-my-heart I-meditate, and-searches my-spirit.

**7** Will-forever reject the-Lord, and-not will-he-be-favorable again?

**8** Has-ceased to-perpetuity his-steadfast-love? Has-ended the-promise for-generation and-generation?

**9** Has-forgotten to-be-gracious God? Or-has-he-shut-up in-anger his-compassion? Selah.

**10** And-I-said, 'My-grief this — the-changing-of right-hand-of the-Most-High.'

**11** I-will-remember the-deeds-of Yah; surely I-will-remember from-of-old your-wonder.

**12** And-I-will-meditate on-all your-work, and-on-your-deeds I-will-muse.

**13** O-God in-the-holiness your-way; what god great like-God?

**14** You-are the-God doing wonder; you-have-made-known among-the-peoples your-strength.

**15** You-redeemed with-your-arm your-people, the-sons-of Jacob and-Joseph. Selah.

**16** Saw-you the-waters O-God, saw-you the-waters they-writhed; also trembled the-depths.

**17** Poured-out waters the-clouds; gave-forth a-sound the-skies; also your-arrows went-about.

**18** The-sound-of your-thunder in-the-whirlwind; lit-up lightnings the-world; trembled and-shook the-earth.

**19** In-the-sea your-way, and-your-path in-waters great, and-your-footprints not were-known.

**20** You-led like-a-flock your-people, by-hand-of Moses and-Aaron.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **77:10**: Hebrew challoti — variously 'my grief/sickness' or 'my prayer/entreaty'; shenot ('changing/years') of the right hand — pivot verse of the psalm.

- **77:16-19**: Theophany at the sea: cosmic language (waters writhing, depths trembling, arrows/lightning) applied to the Exodus crossing.

— EMET
